CONSENT CALENDAR
The Consent Calendar adopting the printed recommended actions will be enacted with one vote. If Councilmembers or Staff wish to address any item on the Consent Calendar
individually, it will be considered under SPECIAL CALL ITEMS.
1.
Minutes of the Utility Board Meeting on September 27, 2021 Recommendation: 1) Approve Minutes as written.
E-1.1. Minutes of Utility Board Meeting of 9-27-21
2.
Approve a Purchase Order with Orravan Mechanical, Inc. for the Amount of $179,024.63 to Replace the Light & Water Administration Building’s HVAC Chiller Unit and Controls System Recommendation: 1) Approve the Purchase Order to Orravan Mechanical Inc. in the amount not-to-exceed $162,749.66 plus a contingency allowance of $16,274.97 (10%) for potential change orders required for unforeseen conditions to replace the ALW administration building’s chiller unit and controls system.
E-2.1. Approve Purchase Order for HVAC Chiller and Controls Replacement
E-2.2. Orravan Mechanical Quotes
E-2.3. Inland Mechanical Services Quotes
3.
Approve and Adopt a Low Carbon Fuel Standard Clean Fuel Reward (CFR) Joinder Agreement Recommendation: 1) Approve ALW to join the Clean Fuel Rewards Joinder Agreement; and 2) Authorize the Director of Utilities to execute the Clean Fuel Rewards Joinder Agreement in a form acceptable to the City Attorney.
E-3.1. Clean Fuels Reward Program UB Consent
E-3.2. CFR Joinder Agreement
E-3.3. CFR Governance Agreement
4.
Approve First Amendment to the Professional Services Agreement for Inspection Services to MWH Constructors for Water Capital Improvement Project W-277 Recommendation: 1) Approve the First Amendment to the Professional Services Agreement ("First Amendment") adding $36,000 for Construction Management and Inspection Services to MWH Constructors, for a total not to exceed amount of $134,750, for Water Project W-277; and 2) Authorize the Mayor to execute the First Amendment, in a form acceptable to the City Attorney, on behalf of the City.
E-4.1. MWH PSA First Amendment
E-4.2. First Amendment to Professional Services Agreement
E-4.3. MWH Constructors Proposal Letter
5.
Approval of Consent, Estoppel and Amendment to Renewable Power Purchase and Sale Agreement Between City of Azusa and Mesa Wind Power Corporation Recommendation: 1) Approve the Amendment to Renewable Power Purchase and Sale Agreement between the City of Azusa and Mesa Wind Power Corporation; and 2) Approve a Consent and Agreement among City of Azusa, Mesa Wind Power LLC, and Wells Fargo Bank; and 3) Approve an Estoppel Certificate.
E-5.1. Approval of Amendment to Renewable Power Purchase and Sale Agreement
E-5.2. Amendment
E-5.3. Consent and Agreement
E-5.4. Estoppel Certificate
